title: ClearHead Workspace Manifest
description: Per-workspace identity manifest, stored at .clearhead/workspace.json. Holds the durable facts that identify a workspace concept, kept deliberately separate from config.json: identity is a tool-managed fact about one workspace, not a human-authored setting, and it does NOT participate in the config precedence chain (global -> project -> local -> env -> args). The manifest is near-static: it changes on init and rename, essentially never otherwise. It carries workspace-level facts only; per-charter, per-action, and per-plan metadata live in their co-located sidecars (see charter_metadata.schema.json), never here.

workspace_id.description: The workspace's durable identity, assigned once by `clearhead init` (UUIDv7). The named graph URI is derived from it as urn:clearhead:workspace:<workspace_id>. Never regenerated in normal operation. May be absent: a workspace without it is still fully queryable, with the read side minting an ephemeral per-load graph identity. `init` is how a workspace earns a durable URI — offered, never forced.

workspace_name.description: Display name used in multi-workspace output and cross-workspace reference syntax (name:charter/action). Inferred from the project directory name by `init`; can be overridden manually.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date recording when the workspace was initialized. Informational only.
